gemini_settings.title: Gemini settings
gemini_settings.description: Shared AI parsing configuration for staff. Change the key or model here without restarting the server. Saved keys are never displayed or sent back to the browser.
gemini_settings.environment: No database settings saved yet. Existing server environment values are used if present; the first Save adopts them unless you replace or remove the key.
gemini_settings.database: Using saved CRM settings. Legacy environment values are ignored, including after removing the saved key.
gemini_settings.ready: A key and model are configured. Compatibility is checked only by an explicitly approved parsing request.
gemini_settings.not_ready: AI parsing is disabled until a key and model are configured. Free table parsing remains available.
gemini_settings.key_saved: Key configured — leave blank to keep it
gemini_settings.key_help: Enter a replacement key, or leave blank to keep the current key. This is a shared server-side setting, not a personal account credential.
gemini_settings.remove_key: Remove the saved key and disable AI parsing
gemini_settings.model_help: Refresh the available models or enter an exact Gemini model ID. No model list is hardcoded. Leave blank to disable AI while retaining the key.
gemini_settings.models_loaded: Loaded {count} generation models. Choose a suggestion in the model field or enter an exact ID.
gemini_settings.refresh_failed: Could not refresh Gemini models. Check the key and project permissions, then retry.
gemini_settings.save_failed: Could not save Gemini settings. Your existing configuration was kept; please try again.
gemini_settings.cost_notice: Save and Refresh models make no paid generation requests. The list filters known special-purpose models but does not prove image/PDF/JSON support. Clicking Generate authorizes the disclosed paid parsing call. A configuration change rejects requests using old settings before billing; check the current model and click Generate again.
